logline: At the height of Catherine and Rupert's lavish wedding, Juliana is paraded before high society in chains to be publicly disgraced—until a deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander's vengeful assault.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 40 where Rupert and Catherine met at the altar; Catherine halts the vows to stage a public humiliation of Juliana, unaware that Alexander's forces are already detonating the cathedral gates.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide symmetrical shot looking down the candlelit, flower-strewn aisle toward the altar where Rupert, Catherine, and the Priest stand.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine abruptly pulls away from Rupert and raises her white-gloved hand high, commanding silence from the congregation.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Imperious, Commanding)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Wait.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot tracking Catherine as she pivots toward the seated aristocracy, her veil floating gracefully behind her.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Haughty, Loud)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's face, her lips curling into a sadistic, triumphant sneer.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Resonant)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: ...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot profile of Rupert and Catherine. Rupert turns to her with mild caution.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Subdued, Inquiring)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Catherine...

segments.label: CATHERINE (Callous, Projecting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Bring her in.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot from behind the altar down the aisle as the great church doors slowly open, revealing the silhouette of three figures against the daylight.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Taunting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: There she is.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Gleeful, Whispering)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: Look at her.

segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Chuckling)
segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
segments.text: She actually came back to the chapel.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Scornful, Smug)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: Not as a bride this time.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.

segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Derisive, Projecting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.

segments.label: CATHERINE (V.O.) (Mocking, Resonant)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: This is the world you thought you belonged to.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Spiteful, Boastful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: And now they can all see what you truly are.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.

segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Unbowed)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Dramatic low-angle full shot looking up at Juliana, her posture straight, imposing, and regal despite the heavy chains.

segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Murmured, Cold)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Still arrogant. Still standing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot of Catherine turning back to Rupert at the altar, dismissing Juliana's defiance as beneath her.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Dismissive)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Come.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's and Rupert's gloved hands clasping together over the velvet altar cushion.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Catherine gazing up adoringly into Rupert's eyes, her tone intoxicatingly intimate.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Intimate, Ambitious)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Rupert's face breaking into a calculating, ambitious grin.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Quietly Triumphant)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Nothing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the elderly Priest opening the leather-bound liturgical book between Rupert and Catherine.

segments.label: PRIEST (Solemn, Polite)
segments.speaker: PRIEST
segments.text: Shall we?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot centered down the aisle toward the massive closed entrance doors.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Rapid series of panic shots: aristocratic guests ducking behind pews, covering their heads in terror, women shrieking as plaster rains down.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine and Rupert at the altar. Catherine gasps in horror, clutching her veil as debris rains over her bridal gown while Rupert spins around in shock.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium wide shot of Juliana standing motionless in the middle of the aisle while thick smoke and dust billow from the demolished archway behind her.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Silhouetted armed figures emerge through the smoke and rubble of the breached doorway. Juliana slowly turns her head, glancing back toward the light.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up pushing in on Juliana's bruised face. Her expression shifts from grim resolve into awe, breathless realization, and blooming hope as the orchestral score swells into an abrupt cliffhanger.
